answer: Think of Attested airport ground handler certificate with airport authority attestation as a toll booth: a certificate the authority renews after airside training, so the atlas of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The cipher is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The jade is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
